messages:
sam: heads up — multiple users in tenant=acme-west are getting created without roles after SSO today. saw it around 09:12
maya: repro? any error in JIT logs?
sam: yes — JIT provisioning runs but role lookup returns [] then default to viewer. happen for users who have `tenant_affinity` claim set to `acme-west`, but only when `groups` is empty
ashley: that sounds like the new role_filter_by_tenant change we rolled last week. it checks (tenant_affinity, groups, roles) in that order
jordan: can you paste the raw assertion (redact PII) or the SAML attributes from the audit log? :mag:
sam: pasted minimal snippet in case useful:
```
<saml:Attribute Name="tenant_affinity">acme-west</saml:Attribute>
<saml:Attribute Name="eduPersonPrincipalName">alice@acme.com</saml:Attribute>
<saml:Attribute Name="groups" />
<saml:Attribute Name="roles" />
```
maya: aha — empty `groups` and `roles` elements break our parser path. code assumes missing elements -> fallback, but empty nodes -> treat as present and short-circuit filter.
ashley: so JIT hits role_filter_by_tenant, sees tenant_affinity, then tries `groups` lookup scoped to tenant -> gets empty -> returns empty allowed_roles -> assign default. regress compared to previous behavior
maya: created a quick patch that treats empty attribute nodes as absent. pushing to staging now
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for eng-svc/idp-mapper v1.3.5-canary
devsec-bot: noisy audit enabled for SSO JIT flows between 09:00-10:30. logs shipped to secure-audit-bucket (encrypted via KMS key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd)
sam: thanks — can we also re-run provisioning for affected accounts? need to restore admin roles for a few users
jordan: snapshot of affected users -> creating bulk re-sync job that will re-evaluate mapping after the canary
maya: re-sync job uses the same mapping code from staging. will only reassign if new role != current. adding safety check to avoid transient elevation
ashley: also adding an audit marker `jit:role_reassign=true` with KMS-encrypted payload so infra can prove change reason for compliance
oncall-sre: FYI, I saw 3 incidents tied to auth failures on the support queue. looks like user-facing impact was 'no access' not elevated perms :white_check_mark:
sam: can we add an immediate alert for empty-attribute rates > 0.5% of SAML assertions? this will catch similar regressions
maya: yep adding metric `saml.empty_attr_rate` and an alert to pager duty if >0.5% over 5m
devsec-bot: suggested mitigation: normalize SAML attribute handling OR force IdP to omit empty tags. reached out to IdP owners (okta-team) for long-term fix
ashley: quick postmortem note — root cause was logic change in role_filter_by_tenant combined with treating empty XML attributes as present. change slipped through unit tests because tests used omitted attributes not empty tags
jordan: test added: cover empty <Attribute/> cases + integration test with sample Okta responses
maya: will roll out full release after 30m canary window if no regressions
deploy-bot: canary passed 15m smoke, promoting to prod in 10m
sam: once prod is up, I'll kick off reassign and will post CSV of changed accounts to #security (sensitive file perms on)
oncall-sre: documenting in incident tracker, tagging compliance for audit trail
ashley: good catch all — also adding a follow-up to check other attribute-parsing code paths (email aliases, department, employeeNumber)
sam: thanks team :heart:
